title: Financial aid and scholarship search
description: Find plausible financial aid and scholarship options for a student, filter to eligible and unique entries, and compile deadlines and requirements.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: financial-aid-search
  title: Financial aid and scholarship search
  description: Find plausible financial aid and scholarship options for a student, filter to eligible and unique entries, and compile deadlines and requirements.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce a deduplicated, eligibility-filtered list of financial aid and scholarship options with compiled deadlines and requirements.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 2
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor: []
  nodes:
    - id: student-financial-profile
      kind: input
      name: Student and family financial profile
      summary: The student's academic profile, family financial situation, and target schools or programs.
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: "The student's academic profile, family financial situation, and target schools or programs." }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: aid-scholarship-finder
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Aid and scholarship finder
      summary: Searches for categories of aid and scholarships that could match the student.
      role: Financial aid and scholarship researcher
      prompt: Search for categories of financial aid, grants, and scholarships that could plausibly match the student's profile, such as need-based aid, merit scholarships, local or community scholarships, and field-of-study scholarships. Describe what official sources to check, such as FAFSA, school financial aid pages, and scholarship databases, rather than inventing specific award amounts or deadlines you have not verified. This is not financial advice, and the family should confirm every detail on the official aid office or scholarship provider page before applying.
      capabilities: { skills: [research], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: filter-eligible
      kind: transform
      name: Filter to likely-eligible options
      summary: Keeps only aid and scholarships the student plausibly qualifies for.
      config: { operation: filter, expression: "keep only aid and scholarships the student plausibly qualifies for" }
    - id: dedup-options
      kind: transform
      name: Remove duplicate listings
      summary: Removes duplicate aid and scholarship entries found across sources.
      config: { operation: deduplicate, expression: "remove duplicate aid and scholarship entries across sources" }
    - id: compile-deadlines-requirements
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Deadline and requirements compiler
      summary: Compiles application requirements and deadline structure for each option.
      role: Financial aid deadline and requirements compiler
      prompt: For each remaining aid or scholarship option, compile the application requirements and deadline structure, noting where the family must verify the exact date and document list on the official page. Do not fabricate specific deadlines or amounts; flag anything unverified as needing confirmation. This is informational only, not financial advice, and the family must confirm final details with the official aid office or scholarship page before applying.
      capabilities: { skills: [product-management], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: collect-aid-options
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect final aid list
      summary: Collects the compiled aid and scholarship entries into one list.
      config: { aggregation: collect }
    - id: aid-options-output
      kind: output
      name: Financial aid and scholarship shortlist
      summary: The final filtered, deduplicated list with deadlines and requirements.
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: student-financial-profile, to: aid-scholarship-finder, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: aid-scholarship-finder, to: filter-eligible, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: filter-eligible, to: dedup-options, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: dedup-options, to: compile-deadlines-requirements, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: compile-deadlines-requirements, to: collect-aid-options, kind: data }
    - { id: e6, from: collect-aid-options, to: aid-options-output, kind: data }
